title: Export diagnostics bundle
desc: When you hit a problem, export a diagnostics bundle and attach it to your GitHub issue so we can locate the cause faster. The bundle is generated locally and never uploaded anywhere. You can preview everything before downloading, and open each file in a text editor after unzipping.
in1: Version, OS and architecture, CPU / memory / disk totals, uptime
in3: Configuration structure: field names, numbers, switches, and enums such as protocol and mode
in4: Recent runtime logs (optional), with IPs, domains, e-mails and URLs masked
ex1: Passwords, tokens, keys, certificates and private keys (including SSH passwords and keys)
ex2: Domain names, host names, real IP and MAC addresses (only categories such as private / public are kept)
ex3: Admin account, API tokens, Docker container environment variables, file contents and terminal sessions
ex4: Names, remarks and other text you typed (replaced by {tag} in the configuration)
logsHint: Logs are the most useful for runtime errors, so keeping them is recommended.
note: A name you typed may occasionally show up in logs, so preview before posting.
previewHint: This is everything that will be exported. There are no hidden files.
